title: Understanding the Vectors
text: The vectors $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ are columns of a matrix U. They are orthogonal unit vectors. What does this imply about their combination?

title: Orthogonality and Unit Vectors
text: Orthogonal unit vectors are linearly independent. This means that no vector can be written as a linear combination of the others. How does this affect the validity of their combination?

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Since $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ are orthogonal unit vectors, they are linearly independent. Therefore, any combination of these vectors is valid. Is the combination of values of $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ invalid?
